summary.en-US: Faster account health and industry updates for authorized Odoo Customer Success users.

description.en-US: Internal Odoo subscription shortcuts for account health and customer industry. Runs only on www.odoo.com/odoo*, uses the current Odoo session, and sends no data to external services. This is not an installable Odoo module or an official Odoo product.

privacy_policy.en-US: OdooHealthExtCS processes account-health and customer-industry data only in the browser and through the user's current same-origin Odoo session to perform explicit user actions. It sends no Odoo page data to the developer or external services, uses no analytics or advertising, and stores only extension preferences plus a sanitized compatibility status. Full policy: https://daviddemri26.github.io/OdooHealthExtCS/privacy.html

release_notes.en-US: Initial release with account-health controls, a searchable industry drawer, settings, safe Undo, and light/dark appearance.

version.approval_notes: Built from the attached human-readable source archive with Node 22 and pnpm 10. The web-ext static innerHTML notices originate in the generated React runtime; extension source does not use dangerouslySetInnerHTML or process untrusted HTML.
